items.title: 56711_Buster Smith oral history interview
items.q: But Anderson, he was the second trumpet player, and he'd take solos.

ctx.x: Which one of them took the solos? Who was the sort of get-off man of that lot?

Anderson [PROBABLY BUDDY ANDERSON]. And this other boy played trumpet. I forget now just who he was. But Davis played first trumpet. He wouldn't take no solos. But Anderson, he was the second trumpet player, and he'd take solos. When I went to Kansas City this last time, he wasn't around there. Neither one of them was around there. Let me see. I can't think of who the other boy was.
